_help: Fallback used ONLY for a platform with no API credentials. Set live to true and fill in the real title, thumbnail URL and stream URL when going live; set it back to false afterwards. Leave a platform out entirely if you do not want to manage it manually. 'youtube' is the first YouTube channel, 'youtube2' the second. embedId = YouTube video id / Twitch channel / Kick slug (enables the preview player).
